description: This file contains the implementation of the CustomerAttributeService interface in a Spring-based Java application, providing methods to manage customer attributes, including CRUD operations and retrievals based on various identifiers.

classes.name: CustomerAttributeServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of CustomerAttributeService providing CRUD operations and retrieval of customer attributes based on various parameters for a specific store and customer context.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new CustomerAttribute or updates an existing one based on its ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a CustomerAttribute, overriding default behavior to handle detached instances.

methods.name: getByCustomerOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerAttribute based on customer option ID within a specific store.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves all CustomerAttributes for a given Customer in a store.

methods.name: getByCustomerOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves CustomerAttributes associated with a specific customer option value ID.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves CustomerAttributes based on a specific option ID within a store.
